title: Ragnar Stats
description: Minecraft mod that adds Ragnarok-inspired stats to your character.
body:
RagnarStats transforms Minecraft into a deeper RPG experience inspired by Ragnarok Online, introducing a full stat system, levels, and stat points to customize your character.

✨ Core Features

Classic Stat System:
- STR – Increases physical damage.
- AGI – Boosts attack speed and evasion.
- VIT – Raises max health, defense, and regeneration.
- INT – Enhances magic damage, magic defense, and mana.
- DEX – Improves accuracy, minimum damage, and reduces cast time.
- LUK – Increases critical chance and “perfect dodge.”

Secondary Stats (RO-style):
- ATK / MATK – Total physical and magical damage.
- DEF / MDEF – Hard and soft defense against damage.
- HIT / FLEE – Accuracy and evasion.
- ASPD – Attack speed.
- Critical / Perfect Dodge – Critical hit and flawless evasion rates.

Level & Experience System:
- Gain EXP by defeating mobs.
- Leveling up rewards you with Stat Points to freely allocate into your attributes.

Dedicated Interface:
- Open the stat menu with a configurable hotkey.
- From there, you can:
  - View your current attributes and secondary stats.
  - Assign stat points manually.
  - Track your level, EXP, and progress toward the next.
